anchors.manufacturability: two blockers (floating/1 mm-thread screws; README hardware vs model)

issues.problem: All tray bosses (M5 land, M4 fin, cover, board standoffs, RJ45 pad) are removed by the bay cavity cut in build_tray_half
issues.evidence: fasteners warns: M5 heads stand 6.0 mm off, M4 4.0 mm off, 10 cover screws 'no material grips', board screws 1-2 mm thread (needs 6); ray 126,29.536,-1.828 -> land 3.0 mm; ray 74,12.265,15 down -> floor z -64; sec_x125_tray.png
issues.fix: union bosses after the bay subtract: land 22x22x9, M4 14x14x8, cover 10x10x14 with Ø2.5x10 pilot, standoffs Ø6.5x5 with Ø2.5x6 pilot, RJ45 pad 44x38x3

issues.problem: Unit hangs on 4 M5 in one row, 20 mm above the only plate contact (40 mm land); grip ~230 mm behind plate
issues.evidence: front face 4.4 mm off plate at z -30, ~27 mm at z -115; 150 N per grip -> ~1.7 kN on the half's two M5 through a 3 mm wall
issues.fix: front face on the plate (bevel 0) to the bridge floor + second M5 row at u ~ -55 (lever ~75 mm, bolt load /3.7), or 15-deg wedge pads 22x22 with one M5 each at the fin bottoms

issues.problem: No usable overload stop for the 20 kg cell: 0.50 mm in push, none in pull
issues.evidence: review_rows distances FAIL 0.50 mm (max 0.15); slide_out stops at 0.55 mm
issues.fix: M4 hex-head stop screws in captive nuts, set at 0.10 mm feeler, push and pull lug (3 mm); or 50 kg cell with 0.3 mm printed stop

issues.problem: Sleeve friction hysteresis and zero-clearance key rib
issues.evidence: 45 mm sleeve, 80 mm to grip centre -> friction 0.46-1.4 x vertical hand load; piston-fin 0.007 mm / -0.496 mm3 along y106-147; review rows min 0.2 FAIL
issues.fix: drop rib root fillet or 1.0 chamfer on slot edges (0.4/side); sleeve >= 90 mm or two 1.2 mm leaf flexures; prismatic joint +-0.5 and fits min 0.2

issues.problem: README hardware/steps contradict the model and lab stock (M8 vs M5, csk+nut vs self-tap, x20 vs x16, 12 vs 8 board screws, covers unlisted); HANDOFF 'never thread into plastic' broken by 30 self-tappers
issues.evidence: manifest FST_ rows vs README Hardware table; cad bom: 40 modelled screws in no row
issues.fix: M5 hex x16 mount, M4 hex x20 with Ø9.5 cbores, M3 self-tap x30 clamshell (or M3 hex x35 + 5.6 AF pockets); regenerate README table from manifest

issues.problem: Grip spigot printed standing: bending across layers
issues.evidence: Ø22.2/16 tube Z=784 mm3, 68 mm arm: 13 MPa at 150 N, 26 MPa at 300 N vs 15 MPa interlayer
issues.fix: print piston on its side with 1.5 mm flat under the spigot; or bore Ø12 with side access for the rear nut; add flexures/interlayer row

issues.problem: Rear M5 nut needs 180 mm reach down the Ø16 bore; README extension gives ~175; spanner/socket not in lab tool list
issues.evidence: piston bbox y292, rear nut top y116.2
issues.fix: reach <= 140 mm, or captive 8.1 AF x 4.5 hex pocket in the piston so the piston threads onto the stud

issues.problem: Cover blocked straight up by the leaning plate; cell service ~22 fastener ops incl. fin removal
issues.evidence: slide_out +Z blocked by BUY_corpus_back_plate at 2 mm; along plate face 0.00 mm to tray
issues.fix: cover front edge 3 mm behind plate line; clamshell M3 heads to outboard face with plugs

issues.problem: No cable lead lengths; patch cable kink R2.8 (OD 5)
issues.fix: cable_leads; coupler horizontal on the rear wall at z ~ -40 for a straight 40 mm patch

issues.problem: No single radius family; irregular empty cover-screw pattern in hero
issues.evidence: fin R4/6/10/12, tray R0.5/1/2/4, cover R0.5/1/1.5/4; cover screws front x 70/145, rear 25/75/125; 01_hero.png, 04_top.png
